title: polystichum minimum
intro: Polystichum minimum, commonly known as the dwarf holly fern, is a species of fern found in North America. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum minimum have been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, respiratory problems, and digestive issues.
